subject: mathematics
instructions: Work independently. Show the mathematical steps or representation that support each response.
Check each result before submitting. A response without the requested work may require adult review.

learnerTasks.prompt: A rectangle has area 21 square units and one side is 3 units. What is the length of the other side?
A line plot shows 6 ribbon lengths to the nearest 1/2 yard: 2/2, 1/2, 2/2, 1/2, 1/2, 1/2. What is the combined length, in a fraction of a yard, of all ribbons measuring exactly 2/2 yard?
A tank has 442 liters of water. 5 containers of 80 liters each are drained from it. How many liters remain?
A rectangle has area 54 square units and one side is 6 units. What is the length of the other side?
A line plot shows 8 ribbon lengths to the nearest 1/4 yard: 1/4, 3/4, 2/4, 2/4, 2/4, 1/4, 1/4, 1/4. What is the combined length, in a fraction of a yard, of all ribbons measuring exactly 1/4 yard?
A hiker walks 352 meters, then walks 3 more trips of 146 meters each. How many meters total?
A rectangle has area 154 square units and one side is 11 units. What is the length of the other side?
A line plot shows 8 ribbon lengths to the nearest 1/8 yard: 7/8, 3/8, 2/8, 1/8, 5/8, 3/8, 4/8, 6/8. What is the combined length, in a fraction of a yard, of all ribbons measuring exactly 5/8 yard?
